fusions.name: Cull the Ailing
fusions.desc: Leaps up to 6 tiles to the target and deals 14 slashing damage, 10% more for each affliction already on it, up to 50% more, and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Scratch Fever
fusions.desc: A scratch that deals 4 slashing damage and leaves the target with Rot for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Soft Landing
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you restore 10 health.

fusions.name: Spare Lives
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
